About Online Resume ATS

We built Online Resume ATS because we believe job seekers shouldn't have to pay $30/month just to check if their resume will pass an ATS system.

Our Mission

Every day, millions of resumes are rejected by Applicant Tracking Systems before a human ever reads them. The tools that help you beat these systems charge premium prices and often require you to upload sensitive personal data to their servers.

We're changing that. Online Resume ATS provides enterprise-quality ATS tools that are completely free, require no sign-up, and process everything locally in your browser.

Privacy First

Your resume contains your name, email, phone number, work history, and more. We believe that data should stay on your computer. That's why every tool on this site processes your data entirely in your browser using JavaScript. No server uploads, no cookies tracking your resume content, no database of user resumes.

How It Works

Our tools use rule-based analysis and keyword matching algorithms that run directly in your browser. When you upload a PDF, we use pdf.js (an open-source library by Mozilla) to parse it locally. Your resume text never leaves your device.

Our Tools

  • ATS Score Checker — Compare your resume against any job description and get a compatibility score with actionable feedback.
  • Cover Letter Generator — Generate professional cover letters using your resume data with 5 industry-specific templates.
  • Domain Converter — Our unique tool that translates your resume language for specific industries like Fintech, Gaming, Healthcare, and more.
  • Keyword Analyzer — Extract and categorize keywords from your resume, find gaps, and get power word suggestions.

Why Free?

We sustain this project through minimal, non-intrusive advertising. We will never paywall features, limit scans, or require sign-up. If you find this tool useful, sharing it with friends who are job hunting is the best way to support us.
